definition: Human–AI interaction is a field of research and a sub-field of human–computer interaction, focusing on user experience and psychological factors.
details: With the proliferation of artificial intelligence (AI), there has developed a subsection of HCI research dedicated to artificial intelligence and how people interact with and are impacted by it.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. In plain words: Human–AI interaction is a field of research and a sub-field of human–computer interaction, focusing on user experience and psychological factors. Here is how it actually plays out: With the proliferation of artificial intelligence (AI), there has developed a subsection of HCI research dedicated to artificial intelligence and how people interact with and are impacted by it.
